name: Omao
rangeDescription: Highlands of hawaii
description: A plump thrush of dense native forests above 3,000 feet elevation on the eastern side of Hawaii Island. Also occurs sparsely in high montane shrubland.

name: Black Oropendola
rangeDescription: Humid lowlands of eastern panama and northern colombia
description: Distinctive large oropendola with a small range from eastern Panama into Colombia. Overall black with dark chestnut on back and wings.

name: Isabelline Wheatear
rangeDescription: South-central eurasia; winters to northeastern africa, arabia, and india
description: A large pale wheatear. Gray-brown above with warm orangish tones on white underparts and a pale white eyebrow.

name: Unicolored Tapaculo
rangeDescription: Andes of northern peru (southern cajamarca and la libertad) and adjacent ecuador
description: Small, gray bird found only in the western Andes of northern Peru. Adult is plain gray, lacking any black or brown barring on lower underparts.

name: White-crowned Pigeon
rangeDescription: Southern florida and offshore islands from west indies to northwestern panama
description: Large dark pigeon, entirely dark gray with contrasting white cap. Pink legs and pink bill with a pale tip.

name: Such's Antthrush
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (minas gerais and espírito santo to northeastern santa catarina)
description: Plump anthrush with a short cocked-tail and long legs. Walks quietly on the ground of humid montane forests between 200 and 1500 m, where it is usually very difficult to see.

name: Masked Bunting
rangeDescription: Sakhalin and southern kuril islands to honshu; winters to ryukyu islands (southern japan)
description: A small migratory songbird breeding in low to mid-elevation, moist mixed forest and wintering in woodland and scrub, preferring thick undergrowth, especially dwarf bamboo. Brown, streaked upperparts, grayish head and pale yellow underparts with fine, dark streaking.

name: Palawan Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Lowlands of palawan (southwestern philippines)
description: A small bird of lowland and foothill forest on Palawan. Favors undergrowth with palms or bamboo.

name: Sooty Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Southeastern bolivia to central argentina, eastern paraguay, uruguay, and southern brazil
description: A very small and long-tailed flycatcher with fairly uniformly dark-gray plumage. It has a dark bill and legs with a slightly paler throat and two indistinct wingbars.

name: White-bellied Dacnis
rangeDescription: Southeastern colombia to southern venezuela, northeastern peru, and central amazonian brazil
description: Small, handsome tanager with piercing yellow eyes. Males are mostly cobalt-blue with a white belly and a black mask.

name: White-winged Flufftail
rangeDescription: Highlands of ethiopia and eastern south africa
description: Very rare, small rail of montane marshes. Extremely shy and elusive bird that is unlikely to be seen unless expressly looking for it.

name: White-winged Tapaculo
rangeDescription: East slope of the andes of northern peru (amazonas, south of the río marañón, to huánuco, north of the río huallaga)
description: Described to science in 2020, this tapaculo was long overlooked due to its similarity with other species. It ranges in high elevation cloud forest along the east slope of the Andes in northern and central Peru.

name: Santa Marta Tapaculo
rangeDescription: Santa marta mountains (northeastern colombia)
description: Small, mouse-like bird found in cloud forest understory in Colombia’s Santa Marta Mountains. Adult male is gray with a white crown patch and rusty barring on the lower underparts.

name: Red-crested Turaco
rangeDescription: Locally in woodland and savanna of western angola
description: A long-tailed, bulky greenish turaco with a yellow bill, a red crest (sometimes tipped white) extending down the nape, and a whitish face. In flight, it explodes from the canopy, showing distinctive deep red panels in the wings.

name: Verreaux's Eagle
rangeDescription: Locally in sub-saharan africa and southern arabian peninsula
description: Spectacular large black eagle. Distinctive in flight, when it shows a long tail and long wings that pinch in at the base.

name: Inca Flycatcher
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of peru (amazonas to cusco)
description: Fairly small flycatcher that perches upright in the mid-story of montane forest and cloud forest. Subtly colorful, with a diffuse gray facial pattern.

name: Yellow-billed Magpie
rangeDescription: Interior, coastal valleys, and foothills of central california
description: Large, striking black-and-white bird; related to crows and jays. Unmistakably long tail and bold pattern, especially visible in flight.

name: Five-colored Munia
rangeDescription: Lesser sundas
description: A striking finch with a heavy silvery bill, a dark coppery hood, a brilliant white underside, and chestnut upperparts. Juveniles duller, with paler head and browner upperparts.

name: White-browed Bushchat
rangeDescription: Arid plains of southern afghanistan, eastern pakistan, and northwestern india
description: A small stonechat-like bird with a relatively long, slim bill. Male has blackish upperparts, a dark face, a white chin, and a whitish, contrasting eyebrow.

name: White-rumped Sirystes
rangeDescription: Western venezuela and eastern colombia southward to southwestern brazil and northwestern bolivia
description: Distinctive black, gray, and white flycatcher of rainforest midstory and canopy. Medium-sized flycatcher with a small bushy crest; white underneath, gray above with a black head, wings, and tail.
